agency.name: Division of Behavioral Health — Substance Use Disorder Services Program, Idaho Department of Health and Welfare

narrNote: Idaho has no affiliate on NARR's official affiliate list (checked 2026-10-22). Idaho recovery residences are not certified through a NARR affiliate.
notes: The agency URL NASADAD lists for Idaho returns 404; the current Department of Health and Welfare substance use disorder page is used instead (title verified: 'About Substance Use Disorder | Idaho Department of Health and Welfare'). Agency phone 1-855-202-0973 is the SUD access line published on that DHW page; it is answered by Magellan of Idaho, the contractor administering the Idaho Behavioral Health Plan (including Medicaid SUD services), not a DHW office line. The Idaho CareLine 2-1-1 address 211.idaho.gov redirects to the DHW 211 page recorded here. The Idaho Crisis & Suicide Hotline is Idaho's designated 988 center; its legacy direct voice line was not confirmed from fetched content in-run, so 988 is the published number.
